notes: The bracketed article at s006 is a real token assimilated into the pointed preposition and takes the written 'the' (rule 12), while the preposition itself is unrepresented because its object is promoted to the direct object of 'cleaveth' (rule 40).

'As when' is read as one rendering of כְּמוֹ, headed on 'As'; the alternative marks 'when' added under rule 55, set aside because a connective morpheme does stand over the clause and rule 30's subtraction finds no morpheme owning the second word in particular.
s004 takes only 'cleaveth', the supplied antecedent 'one' being written once across the coordinated participles (rules 46, 22).
